notes: Two bosses, cleaved the whole fight, on a 155-second cycle. Each cycle brings three Spawn of Vexhul and ten Broodlings of Ithraz. In each intermission Ithraz is out of reach for about 15 seconds while the raid crosses the room.

heroic.notes: Two bosses, cleaved the whole fight. Each cycle brings three Spawn of Vexhul; heroic has no Broodlings. In each intermission Ithraz is out of reach for 10-20 seconds while the raid crosses the room.
